full_judgment: 2. The short facts for disposal of the rule, are that on 17-12-1980 the petitioners and opposite party no. 13 as plaintiffs filed Title Suit no. 929 of 1980 in the Court of learned Subordinate Judge, First Court, Khulna for declaration that the Judgment and Decree dated 14.11.72 passed in Title Suit no.762 of 1969 is void, illegal, collusive and not binding upon the plaintiff and for declaration of title recovery of khas possession and permanent injunction in respect of "Kha" schedule of land. Thereafter the suit was renumbered as Title Suit No. 167 of 1994. The specific case of the plaintiffs in short is that defendant Nos. 3-9 predecessor of defendant Nos. 6-7 Monilal and predecessor of defendant No. 8 Lalit Mohon left this country before 1965 and went to India to reside permanently. Plaintiff No. 1 and defendant No. 11-17 exchanged their property in India with defendant Nos. 3-5 Monilal and Lalit Mohon of Bangladesh vide registered exchanged deed. A Power of attorney was executed in favour of plaintiff No. 1 and defendant Nos. 11-17 to regularize the exchanged deed. Plaintiff No. 1 and defendant Nos. 11-17 sold the suit property to plaintiff Nos. 2-8 vide kabala dated 10.01.1980 and delivered possession thereof. Defendant Nos. 1-2 obtained a fraudulent decree by filing Title Suit No. 762 of 1969 which is not binding upon the plaintiff.
